source_title: Honda Racing Unleashes A 1,300+ HP Hybrid Passport Trophy Truck
source_excerpt:
You're looking at the first hybrid vehicle to compete in Score World Desert Championship's top Trophy Truck class,
We already knew Honda was planning to make its Passport "more masculine," but we had no idea this midsize SUV could become an off-road beast. No, it may not be as cool as a Baja-ready classic Porsche 911 , but Honda gave this rig an engine derived from an endurance racing prototype with a total power output of 1,300 hp (969 kW) — and its sights are set on an overall Baja 1000 victory. None of this is very shocking given that the truck comes from Honda Racing .
Honda's new Passport Baja Spec Trophy Truck will debut at the 2026 SEMA Show, and it was developed with Mason Motorsports. Menzies Motorsports is also a partner, and two-time Baja 1000 winner Bryce Menzies will drive it in Score World Desert Championship's top Trophy Truck class, where Honda says it will be the first hybrid vehicle to compete in this class. This isn't your mom's Passport, so let's talk a little about the racing technology under this trophy truck.
Today's Trophy Trucks leverage 9.0-liter V8s. Honda says that its 2.4-liter V6-based powertrain will make more power. The engine uses a pair of turbochargers and an 800-volt hybrid system to help it achieve its somewhat wild 1,300 hp figure. Interestingly, the V6 shares very close ties with the engine in Acura's ARX-06 GTP race car , giving it some endurance racing credentials, including victories at Daytona and Sebring. That said, surviving Baja will present a different set of challenges.
The hybrid system here is bespoke and a direct product of HRC's work. The battery uses a previous-generation Formula 1-style pouch cell inside a carbon fiber case. Assembly and validation all take place within a clean room at the brand's Santa Clarita headquarters. Of course, the battery is just one piece of the overall system.
Honda says the truck also features brake-by-wire systems on each axle, adaptive traction control, and what it's calling AI power deployment. Proprietary software ties together the powertrain, chassis, and energy management, with adjustments possible during the race. Honda hasn't detailed the battery's capacity or how much power the electric side contributes.
The rear-mounted engine mates to Mason-developed five-speed transmission, and the all-wheel drive setup uses two rear driveshafts, with individual angled gearsets at the rear wheels replacing a conventional ring-and-pinion arrangement. Up front, portal gearsets at the hubs help provide ground clearance. As the photos make clear, this isn't a simple build.
If there's anything here that hints at the production Passport outside of the name, it's very selective sections of the body. Each panel is carbon fiber to save weight. Deep channels behind the front wheels manage airflow, while high-mounted exhaust outlets sit among fins behind the cockpit. Honda also shaped the cab to channel air toward a cooler mounted low and far back in the truck.
Underneath sits a modified version of Mason's Gen 2 AWD chassis. Those modifications include an HRC-specific rear section to accommodate the hybrid hardware. A 145-gallon (549-liter) carbon-Kevlar fuel cell occupies the center of the cab to help keep the balance consistent as fuel burns off. Just for clarity, a gallon of gas weighs around 6.2 pounds. So when it's full, it's around 899 pounds heavier than when it's empty. Batteries and other fixed-weight components sit toward the rear. Dual Fox shocks at each corner and Toyo tires round out the desert hardware.
The trophy truck will be on display at SEMA (November 3–6) alongside a Passport TrailSport Baja Chase truck. Its first scheduled race is the 2027 Baja 500 on June 2–6. After that comes an even bigger ambition. Specifically, an overall Baja 1000 win as the event celebrates its 60th anniversary in 2027. The horsepower is there. Now Honda has to prove the whole package can survive.
hi_body:
## तकनीकी विवरण
होंडा रेसिंग ने अपना 'पासपोर्ट बाजा स्पेक ट्रॉफी ट्रक' पेश किया है, जिसे स्कोर वर्ल्ड डेजर्ट चैंपियनशिप की शीर्ष ट्रॉफी ट्रक श्रेणी में प्रतिस्पर्धा करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। यह श्रेणी में पहला हाइब्रिड वाहन होगा, जिसमें 2.4-लीटर V6-आधारित पावरट्रेन और 800-वोल्ट हाइब्रिड सिस्टम दिया गया है। यह सेटअप कुल 1,300 हॉर्सपावर (969 किलोवाट) उत्पन्न करने में सक्षम है।

इस ट्रक को मेसन मोटरस्पोर्ट्स और मेंजीस मोटरस्पोर्ट्स के सहयोग से विकसित किया गया है। इसमें एक्यूरा ARX-06 GTP रेस कार की तकनीक का उपयोग किया गया है। वाहन का सार्वजनिक अनावरण 2026 SEMA शो में होगा, जबकि इसकी पहली आधिकारिक दौड़ 2027 बाजा 500 में निर्धारित है।

## मुख्य विशेषताएं
* **पावरट्रेन:** 2.4-लीटर ट्विन-टर्बोचार्ज्ड V6 के साथ 800-वोल्ट हाइब्रिड सिस्टम।
* **पावर:** 1,300 एचपी का आउटपुट।
* **चेसिस:** हाइब्रिड घटकों के लिए संशोधित मेसन जेन 2 AWD चेसिस।
* **तकनीक:** ब्रेक-बाय-वायर, एडेप्टिव ट्रैक्शन कंट्रोल और एआई-संचालित पावर डिप्लॉयमेंट सॉफ्टवेयर।
* **बॉडी:** वजन कम करने के लिए कार्बन फाइबर का उपयोग।
* **ईंधन क्षमता:** 145-गैलन (549-लीटर) कार्बन-केवलर फ्यूल सेल।

## रेसिंग लक्ष्य
दो बार के बाजा 1000 विजेता ब्राइस मेंजीस इस ट्रक को चलाएंगे। टीम का मुख्य लक्ष्य 2027 में बाजा 1000 की 60वीं वर्षगांठ पर समग्र जीत हासिल करना है। कंपनी ने अभी बैटरी क्षमता के सटीक आंकड़े जारी नहीं किए हैं, क्योंकि टीम रेगिस्तानी परिस्थितियों के लिए सहनशक्ति परीक्षण पर ध्यान केंद्रित कर रही है।

en_body:
## Technical Overview
Honda Racing has unveiled the Passport Baja Spec Trophy Truck, a high-performance vehicle designed to compete in the Score World Desert Championship's top-tier Trophy Truck class. The vehicle is engineered to be the first hybrid in its class, featuring a 2.4-liter V6-based powertrain paired with an 800-volt hybrid system, delivering an estimated 1,300 hp. 

Developed in collaboration with Mason Motorsports and Menzies Motorsports, the project utilizes technology derived from the Acura ARX-06 GTP endurance racer. The truck is slated for its public debut at the 2026 SEMA Show, with its competitive racing entry scheduled for the 2027 Baja 500.

## Key Specifications
* **Powertrain:** 2.4-liter twin-turbocharged V6 with an 800-volt hybrid system.
* **Power Output:** Rated at 1,300 hp (969 kW).
* **Chassis:** Modified Mason Gen 2 AWD chassis with a custom rear section for hybrid hardware.
* **Technology:** Brake-by-wire, adaptive traction control, and AI-driven power deployment software.
* **Body:** Lightweight carbon fiber construction optimized for airflow.
* **Fuel Capacity:** 145-gallon (549-liter) carbon-Kevlar fuel cell.

## Racing Goals
Two-time Baja 1000 winner Bryce Menzies is set to pilot the vehicle. The primary long-term objective for the team is to secure an overall victory at the 2027 Baja 1000, coinciding with the event's 60th anniversary. Performance data and specific battery capacity figures remain undisclosed as the team focuses on endurance testing for desert terrain.
